description: Manage Arduino Cloud Things and variables, and read device status and historical data.

arduino_cloud_new_device_status_trigger.description: Runs for each new device status event in Arduino Cloud. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields updated_at, value

arduino_cloud_new_device_trigger.description: Runs for each new Arduino Cloud device in Arduino Cloud. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields ble_mac, connection_type, created_at, deleted_at, device_status, events, fqbn, href, id, issuer_ca, label, last_activity_at

arduino_cloud_new_thing_trigger.description: Runs for each new Arduino Cloud Thing in Arduino Cloud. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields assistant, created_at, deleted_at, device_fqbn, device_id, device_name, device_type, href, id, name, organization_id, properties

arduino_cloud_new_variable_trigger.description: Runs for each new Thing variable in Arduino Cloud. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields created_at, deleted_at, href, id, linked_to_trigger, max_value, min_value, name, permission, persist, sync_id

arduino_cloud_variable_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a thing variable changes in Arduino Cloud. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
